title: Grid Marker Demo
description: 1 captured save. One original BASIC player; historical bugs remain.
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: GRID MARKER DEMO
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Ordered lines, consistent pointers, normal end; exact left/right timing decode match; runtime untested
versions.startupSource:
10 C$(0)=".":C$(1)="O":C$(2)="X"
20 DIM L(15,15)
30 CLS:GOSUB1000
40 PRINT@R1*64+C1*4,CHR$(143);:PRINT@R1*64+C1*4,C$(L(R1,C1));
50 A$=INKEY$:IFA$=""THEN60 ELSEIFA$="1"THEN R1=R1-1ELSEIFA$="2"THENR1=R1+1ELSEIFA$="3"THENC1=C1-1ELSEIFA$="4"THENC1=C1+1ELSEIFA$=" "THEN 70ELSEIFA$="5"THENR1=R1-1:C1=C1+1ELSEIFA$="6"THENR1=R1+1:C1=C1-1
55 IF R1=-1THENR1=15ELSEIFR1=16THENR1=0ELSEIFC1=-1THENC1=15ELSEIFC1=16THENC1=0ELSEGOTO60
56 GOTO 55
60 GOTO 40
70 IF L(R1,C1)<>0 THEN 40 ELSE L(R1,C1)=2:PRINT@R1*64+C1*4,C$(L(R1,C1));
80 GOTO 40
1000 FOR R=0TO15:FORC=0TO15:PRINT@ R*64+C*4,C$(L(R,C));:NEXTC,R:RETURN
